welcome.title: Welcome to FruitsBytes
welcome.subtitle: Developer Portfolio
welcome.description: Explore my projects, read my blog, and get in touch
welcome.greeting: Hi, {name} you decided to be known as the {flavor} {type}. Great choice!
welcome.intro1: I am currently exploring video game programing and this website is my playground. It is a work in progress, always evolving
welcome.intro2: For the first time in a long time, I get to finally put my Civil Engineer Math/Physic classes to good use. My interest for video games started at 5 years old, when I received my first NES. Little did I know that the grim artifacts loaded by the corrupted cartridges would bring the same despair 14 years later, while compiling C++ on Borland.
welcome.coding1: My first real coding experience stated circa 1998, when we finally upgraded to SNES. It was the year of the famous football match, Brasil vs France : 0 - 3. My cousin got a VTech and I was able to code using Basic. Growing up, I was introduced to Visual Basic and Ti-Basic on my graphing calculator during my last years in college. I always dreamed of the day when I would be able to help port StarCraft on the Ti-89.
welcome.coding2: The team working on that task made a lot of progress. I wonder what type of version control they were using at the time. Video games were always my passion, my first username was Bleuscyther (Blue + Scyther), my favorate color and my favorite pokemon.
welcome.current: Now after 14 years of building softwares and websites professionally, I try to spend my free time on learning how to produce video games if i am not playing a Paradox game on ironman. My goal is to have enough skills to do a X-Com III preview, Tyranny II (by Obsidian) or even The Movies - Remastered (by LionHead) HD 😅
welcome.cta: In the meantime if you need a software developer or consulting service on your software project hit me up.
welcome.thanks: Thank you for reading this far,
